raw_gpu_metrics.tolerance_of_mapping: Bit names were decoded against the installed amdgpu SMU14 headers. The exact active SMU branch is not independently confirmed because the device reports legacy v1.3 metrics; treat the mapping as strong reason evidence, not an exhaustive driver-internal proof.
raw_gpu_metrics.collection_caveat: The offsets were read separately, so dependent and independent status values are not an atomic pair. One-second CLI polling and sampled temperature/power readings can miss an instantaneous peak.

finding.reported_reason_evidence: Hotspot thermal status was present; one raw dependent status also included PPT0. No TDC bit was observed.
why_not_confirmed: All recorded sampled temperatures remained below the reported slow limits.
All recorded sampled socket powers remained below the reported PPT0 limit.
AMD SMI did not expose a per-reason violation counter.
The raw status fields and CLI values are non-atomic samples.
finding.kernel_log_context: No amdgpu physical-throttle warning was captured during this window. Historical 'failed to disable PTL' messages preceded this window; driver source identifies PTL as KFD profiler control, not a physical throttle-reason report.

measurement_impact.timing: Timing samples collected while THROTTLED is reported are conditional and should be repeated under an all-clear telemetry gate before being used for a performance ranking.
measurement_impact.numerical_gate: The full-model vector failure remains a valid NO-GO. Frequency/power throttle is expected to affect timing, not deterministically create the observed source-tile-correlated vector divergence.
measurement_impact.past_low_temperature_observation: The earlier low-temperature THROTTLED display cannot be retrospectively assigned a unique physical cause.

recommended_future_protocol: Capture all relevant GPU-metrics fields in one atomic read and preserve the raw blob.
Use a cooldown and sustained all-clear condition before timing.
Discard or repeat a timing series if any throttle-reason bit appears.
Evaluate a temporary power-cap experiment only as a separately approved experiment; do not make a permanent power-policy change.
